channel.title: Insider Media Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Insider Media Ltd (insidermedia.com)

item.title: Job-saving deal for struggling logistics business nears completion
item.description: A deal that would save all jobs at a longstanding East Midlands logistics business is expected to be completed after the company filed two notices of intention to appoint administrators.

item.title: Housebuilder announces launch of new South West region
item.description: A newly-formed region of a national housebuilder has marked its official launch at the opening of new offices in Bristol.

item.title: Oushk Pharmacy secures partnership with Carbon Padel to boost North West presence
item.description: The Manchester-founded online pharmacy strengthens its North West presence through a strategic sponsorship at one of the UK’s largest padel facilities.

item.title: 130-strong recruitment business snapped up by US private equity firm valuing it at $100m - provides exit for BGF
item.description: A specialist recruitment company which was founded in New York but has its headquarters in Nottingham has been acquired by a US private equity firm in a deal that values it at $100m and provides an exit for BGF.

item.title: UK business growth ‘slowed to a crawl’ due to war in Middle East, survey shows
item.description: War in the Middle East has stalled growth across the UK’s private sector as companies pin "lost" business on soaring energy prices, longer wait times for raw materials, and more cautious customers, according to a new survey.

item.title: Construction business to open Leeds office to support expansion - follows MBO from listed parent in January
item.description: A construction business that completed a management buyout (MBO) from its listed former owner earlier this year is set to open a new office in Leeds.

item.title: Cheshire hotel which has played host to The Beatles and Gerry and the Pacemakers saved from closure - 60 jobs protected
item.description: A Cheshire hotel, which famously welcomed The Beatles in 1963, has been rescued from insolvency, saving 60 jobs.

item.title: Hotel Gotham rebrands as The Rex
item.description: Hotel Gotham, a luxury boutique hotel prominently located in central Manchester, has rebranded as The Rex, Leonardo Limited Edition UK Hotels has announced.

item.title: £46m forward funding deal agreed for new Leeds hotel - "significant milestone" for development on key site
item.description: A £46m forward funding deal has been agreed to support the construction of a new hotel on a prominent site in Leeds city centre.

item.title: Knights confirms discussions over potential deal for historic law firm
item.description: Knights has confirmed that it is in discussions over a potential acquisition of a law firm which employs hundreds of people and has roots dating back to the 18th century.

item.title: Former Google executive Matt Brittin announced as BBC director-general
item.description: Former Google boss Matt Brittin is to replace Tim Davie as the director-general of the BBC, it has been announced.

item.title: GDP figures show Scotland’s economy flatlined in three months to January
item.description: Scotland’s economy flatlined in the three months to January, new figures have revealed.

item.title: Offshore wind factory could bring 500 jobs to Scotland
item.description: A major offshore wind factory – creating 500 jobs – could be built in Scotland, an energy giant has announced.

item.title: Piccadilly Gardens transformation delivery team appointed
item.description: The team which will deliver the transformation of Piccadilly Gardens in Manchester has been revealed.

item.title: Surface Transforms files second NOI as talks continue with potential interested parties
item.description: Surface Transforms, the stricken manufacturers of carbon fibre reinforced ceramic automotive brake discs based in Knowsley, has filed a second notice of intention to appoint administrators in a move which protects the business against creditor action while it continues to explore options with its advisers.
